newsitem.title: CANADA: Zemex sees EPS-weakening factors continuing.
newsitem.headline: Zemex sees EPS-weakening factors continuing.

text.p: Zemex Corp said Thursday that some of the factors that have depressed results for the first three-quarters of 1996 are expected to continue near-term.
Earlier, the industrial powders and minerals company announced third quarter earnings of $0.10 per share, down from $0.18 in the year-ago period.
Also, results for the nine months to September 30 shrank to $0.20 per share from $0.67.
For the weakness, Zemex cited depressed aluminum prices and weak performance of the atomized product lines in the metal powders group.
